exposure: Duration of arrest at >=6 cm dilation
Cesarean delivery for fetal heart rate concerns
cohort: 4703 cephalic-presenting, term, singleton births with electronic fetal monitoring and cord gases at 2 academic community referral hospitals in 2012 and 2013.
finding: Percentile rankings of dilation or station based on adaptive multifactorial models showed higher discrimination for cesarean delivery interventions compared to duration of arrest at >=6 cm dilation.
